STONEHILL STUD FARM, BALLINVAROSIG, CARRIGALINNE, CO. CORK P43 CP63

Michael Pigott Auctioneer & Valuer proudly brings this remarkable equestrian holding of exceptional quality & scale just a few minutes south of Carrigaline town.  This is a truly outstanding 68-acre equestrian farm, combining an exceptional six-bedroom residence, superb equestrian facilities, extensive ancillary accommodation and magnificent natural surroundings. Stonehill Stud Farm is a property of genuine distinction and is undoubtedly one of the most impressive equestrian holdings to come to the market in the Carrigaline area.

Set amidst a magnificent rolling landscape of mature trees, lush pastureland and established hedgerows, the property extends to approximately 70 acres of beautifully maintained natural pasture, offering an exceptional combination of privacy, scale and amenity. The holding has been thoughtfully developed to provide an outstanding lifestyle property while simultaneously offering first-class facilities for a serious equestrian operation.
It is approached via a beautifully established, tree-lined driveway, creating an impressive and welcoming sense of arrival. The generous tarmacadam avenue is bordered by mature, neatly maintained hedging to one side and a striking avenue of established trees to the other, with adjoining post-and-rail fencing enclosing the surrounding pastureland.

The mature planting provides an exceptional level of privacy and shelter while creating a wonderful leafy, secluded approach to the residence and wider holding. The long, elegant avenue is a particularly attractive feature of the property, giving a strong sense of space and grandeur from the moment one enters the grounds. With its mature landscaping, established boundaries and peaceful rural setting, the approach perfectly complements this exceptional and highly individual property.

The Principal Residence:

At the centre of the holding stands the impressive principal residence, constructed approximately 15 years ago and finished to an exceptionally high standard with lots of charm and character oozing throughout. The house is immediately striking from the aerial approach, with an attractive architectural design, multiple gabled elevations and extensive glazing, all carefully positioned within beautifully landscaped grounds.
Internally, the accommodation is exceptionally generous, with a massive open-plan layout creating an impressive sense of volume, light and space.
The residence provides six beautifully appointed en-suite bedrooms, making it ideally suited to substantial family living, entertaining and accommodating guests. The relationship between the house, gardens and surrounding countryside is particularly impressive, with the residence enjoying a wonderful sense of privacy while remaining very much at the heart of the estate.

Magnificent Grounds & Setting:
 
The approach to Stonehill Stud Farm is via a superb tree-lined tarmacadam avenue, creating an impressive entrance and an immediate sense of arrival. The grounds surrounding the residence have been beautifully landscaped, incorporating mature trees, established hedging, manicured lawns and attractive planting. The aerial photography demonstrates the exceptional setting of the property, with Stonehill enjoying far-reaching views across the surrounding countryside, with the wider landscape extending towards the coast and Cork Harbour.
The combination of mature landscaping, extensive pasture and carefully maintained boundaries gives the entire estate an established and prestigious character.

Exceptional Equestrian Facilities:
For the equestrian enthusiast, the facilities are of an exceptional standard.
Approximately 68 acres of natural pasture are laid out in well-maintained fields, all enclosed by quality timber post-and-rail fencing.

The Yard incorporates:
Approximately 20 state-of-the-art horseboxes
High-quality equestrian facilities
Sand arena
Storage sheds
Spacious haybarn
Excellent access throughout the holding
Extensive post-and-rail paddock system
Exceptional grazing facilities

The scale and quality of the equestrian infrastructure make Stonehill particularly suitable for a professional stud, breeding operation, competition yard or private equestrian estate.

Courtyard & Self-Catering Accommodation:

Adding considerably to the versatility of the property is the impressive courtyard complex. The courtyard is surrounded by attractive ancillary buildings incorporating self-catering accommodation together with an adjoining office, providing an excellent facility for guests, staff, clients or visiting equestrian. The courtyard has been thoughtfully integrated into the overall estate and provides a wonderful additional element to what is already an exceptional property. It offers a stand alone 2 Bedroom Detached House, 2 Bedroom Mews adjoining the office and outbuildings and an overhead 2 Bedroom Apartment with balcony that boasts magnificent views of the incredible surrounds.

VIEWING STRICTLY BY APPOINTMENT ONLY
